title: The 5 Shortest Days in the Solar System, Ranked (#1 Is Under 10 Hours)

scenes.text: The five planets with the shortest days, ranked. Number one spins so fast it bulges at the middle.

scenes.label: Earth · 24 hours
scenes.text: Number five: Earth. Twenty-four hours, and the slowest spinner on this list.

scenes.label: Uranus · 17 hours
scenes.text: Number four: Uranus. A day lasts about seventeen hours, even though the planet spins on its side.

scenes.label: Neptune · 16 hours
scenes.text: Number three: Neptune. A day lasts just sixteen hours, on a world four times wider than Earth.

scenes.label: Saturn · 10.7 hours
scenes.text: Number two: Saturn. A day lasts about ten and a half hours, nine times wider than Earth and still spinning.

scenes.label: Jupiter · 9.9 hours
scenes.text: Number one: Jupiter. A day is under ten hours, and its equator moves forty-five thousand kilometers an hour.

description:
The five planets with the shortest days, ranked by how long one spin takes.
Jupiter turns in just 9.9 hours, which flattens the whole planet.
Which planet would you spend a day on?
first_comment: Which planet's day would you want, the shortest or the longest? What should we rank next?
